$comment: Per-capability fallback chains. The `mcp__claude_ai_*` connectors are authenticated
INTERACTIVELY through claude.ai — they are frequently absent in headless and cron runs.
A skill that only knows the connector silently loses that capability there. Every skill
reading a remote system must walk its chain in order and, when it lands on `degrade`,
SAY SO in one line rather than producing a quietly thinner answer.
This is why the 2-hourly harness-checkin cron must report degradation explicitly: an
autonomous digest that silently omits Calendar looks identical to a day with no meetings.

fallback.note: acli is the Atlassian CLI. Read-only subcommands only; writes stay gated.

jira.degrade: Jira unavailable (no Atlassian connector, no acli) — skipping ticket scope.

confluence.degrade: Confluence unavailable — cannot ground against team docs or flag doc drift.

preferred.read: gh api / gh pr / gh search

github.note: gh is the PREFERRED path, not the fallback — it works headless and is already authenticated.

slack.degrade: Slack unavailable — support queue and channel scans skipped.

fallback.note: Accept a pasted agenda: title, time, attendees.

calendar.degrade: Calendar unavailable — no meeting ingest or prep this run.

fallback.note: Accept a pasted doc link or the transcript text.

drive.degrade: Drive unavailable — Gemini transcripts cannot be fetched automatically.

gmail.note: Gated by the guard hook, so it is DENIED in autonomous runs by design. Never rely on it in cron.
gmail.degrade: Gmail unavailable or gated — skipping the recap-email transcript source.

sentry.degrade: Sentry not configured — add it with `/setup --field integrations`.

datadog.degrade: Datadog not configured — skipping monitor scan.

amplitude.degrade: Amplitude not configured — skipping product analytics.

compass.degrade: Compass alias not set — run `/setup --field team`.

rules: Probe before use. Never assume a connector is present because a skill lists it in allowed-tools.
Walk the chain in order; stop at the first that answers. Never retry a missing tool.
Landing on `degrade` is a REPORTABLE fact: emit its one-line message. Never omit silently.
In autonomous/cron runs, collect every degraded capability and list them once at the end of the digest, so a thin run is distinguishable from a quiet day.
Fallbacks are read-only. A write always goes through the gated path, whatever the transport.
